title: Scale mixed ternary with saved bytes
description: Use ternary only where compression buys capacity without destroying quality, then spend saved bytes on a larger model.
when_to_try: When mixed ternary is close to an int5 baseline but still comfortably under the 16MB cap.
avoid_when: When same-shape mixed ternary is already clearly worse and byte savings are too small to fund a meaningful scale-up.

title: Keep attention higher precision
description: Apply aggressive quantization mainly in the MLP path while keeping attention in a less lossy regime.
when_to_try: When full ternary hurts quality but mixed ternary remains competitive.
avoid_when: When attention is not the quality bottleneck or the artifact is already dominated by embeddings/output layers.

title: Reduce STE learning-rate aggression
description: Ternary and low-bit STE training may need lower matrix learning rates and clipping to avoid instability or collapse.
when_to_try: When loss spikes or sparsity saturates early.
avoid_when: When the current run is stable and underfitting due to too little movement.

title: Treat zero-fraction as a first-class signal
description: Track per-layer zero-fraction and use it to catch collapse or layer-specific dead zones before wasting a full run.
when_to_try: Any time ternary or structured sparsity is used.
avoid_when: Never; this is a diagnostic, not a costly architecture choice.

title: Rebalance bigram hash capacity
description: Treat BigramHash size and dimensionality as a budget knob that can interact strongly with model size and compression choices.
when_to_try: When the transformer body is near a quality plateau but bytes remain.
avoid_when: When the body architecture is still unstable or clearly undertrained.

title: Prefer evaluation-friendly changes late
description: Near a good solution, prioritize changes that preserve fast, deterministic eval and compressed roundtrip behavior.
when_to_try: When model quality is close and the next gains should not jeopardize artifact or eval constraints.
avoid_when: During very early exploration when large architectural leaps still make sense.
